earnings.title: Franklin Lakes, NJ 07417
highlights: Q4 revenue of $5.3 billion increased 5.4% as reported, 5.6% FXN
Q4 GAAP and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.52 and $4.15, respectively
FY26 revenue of $19.5 billion increased 4.9% as reported, 3.9% FXN
FY26 GAAP and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.06 and $12.70, respectively

quotes.text: We delivered a strong fourth quarter, with 5.6% revenue growth and broad-based performance led by our key growth platforms.
quotes.by: Tom Polen, chairman, CEO and president of BD

items.heading: Global economic conditions, including inflation and supply chain disruptions, could continue to adversely affect our operations.
Our international operations subject us to certain business risks.

Market dynamics, changes in reimbursement practices and coverage policies, third-party payer cost containment measures and health insurance coverage levels could affect demand for our products and the prices at which they are sold.
Reductions in customers’ research budgets or government funding may adversely affect our business.
Our future growth is dependent in part upon the development of new products, and there can be no assurance that such products will be developed.
Cybersecurity incidents and breaches or breakdowns of our information and technology systems or infrastructure could have a material adverse effect on our operations.
